name: star-rating
title: Star Rating
description: Star Rating is a free React star rating input for Next.js and Tailwind CSS with half stars, hover preview, drag to rate on touch screens, full keyboard control, a hidden form input and a read only mode for any fraction, drawn either as faceted cut stars lit by a light that follows the pointer or as classic rounded stars, in gold, silver, chili, rose and violet.
author: Wensity <hey@wensity.com>

theme.font-sans: var(--font-satoshi, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif)
theme.font-display: var(--font-satoshi, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif)

light.primitive-font-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

dark.primitive-font-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

docs: Free Wensity component. Installs to @components/wensity/star-rating.tsx. For Pro components and updates, use pnpm dlx wensity@latest add star-rating.
